title: Code, data and manuscript files for "Matthew's Star of Bethlehem is inconsistent with natural objects: evidence from orbital mechanics and corpus linguistics"
description: Orbital-mechanics surveys (heliocentric grid of 529 million configurations, Monte Carlo refinement, geocentric survey, close-flyby campaigns over 10^9 sampled orbits, two-leg itineraries), corpus-linguistic records and statistical scripts, figure files, and the revised manuscript and Supplementary Information for the paper by A. M. Adair, under review at npj Heritage Science (2026).
